lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Guided practice: checking safety and supervision

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 6 — family contribution capstone
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice checking safety and supervision. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Sitting with the step list from day two, the learner goes through it one step at a time and asks the same question for every step: does this step involve heat, a sharp tool, or a chemical cleaner, or does it happen somewhere no one else can see.
safetyNotes: This lesson is a planning discussion only; the learner does not use heat, sharp tools, or a chemical cleaner during this lesson.
If any step on the list is unclear, the safe choice is to label it 'adult right there' rather than guess, and that caution counts as success.
materials: learner-local: the step list from the previous lesson
learner-local: a pencil or marker for labeling

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Was there a step you first thought was safe alone but labeled differently after checking the three hazards? Describe the step and what changed your mind.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Hazard check accuracy: The heat, sharp tool, and chemical cleaner checks are applied consistently to label each step. | Supervision label defensibility: Each label matches the stated hazard reasoning for that step. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner pick one step marked 'adult right there' and write a second, safer version of that same step that could be marked 'learner alone' instead, if a safer version exists.

resources.title: checking safety and supervision worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Sitting with the step list from day two, the learner goes through it one step at a time and asks the same question for every step: does this step involve heat, a sharp tool, or a chemical cleaner, or does it happen somewhere no one else can see.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact checking safety and supervision decision or action.
Model move 2: Before marking anything, reread your step list from the previous lesson start to finish.

Model move 3: Go through your step list one step at a time and mark each step adult right there, adult checking in, or learner alone, based on whether it involves heat, a sharp tool, or a chemical cleaner.

resources.title: checking safety and supervision action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for checking safety and supervision.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-guided-card.

resources.title: checking safety and supervision coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Sitting with the step list from day two, the learner goes through it one step at a time and asks the same question for every step: does this step involve heat, a sharp tool, or a chemical cleaner, or does it happen somewhere no one else can see.
Coach direction: Before marking anything, reread your step list from the previous lesson start to finish.
Learner prompt: Name one step on your list that you are already fairly sure would need an adult nearby, and say why.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: checking safety and supervision complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Go through your step list one step at a time and mark each step adult right there, adult checking in, or learner alone, based on whether it involves heat, a sharp tool, or a chemical cleaner.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I checked every step on my list, not just the ones that looked risky at first glance.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I used the three specific hazard checks (heat, sharp tool, chemical cleaner) instead of just guessing which steps felt risky.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I wrote one label (adult right there, adult checking in, or learner alone) next to every step.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I showed my marked-up list to a guardian and listened to anything they wanted to add or change.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: checking safety and supervision minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Was there a step you first thought was safe alone but labeled differently after checking the three hazards? Describe the step and what changed your mind.

Success checks: Hazard check accuracy: The heat, sharp tool, and chemical cleaner checks are applied consistently to label each step. | Supervision label defensibility: Each label matches the stated hazard reasoning for that step.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: checking safety and supervision supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional checking safety and supervision condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Hazard check accuracy: The heat, sharp tool, and chemical cleaner checks are applied consistently to label each step. | Supervision label defensibility: Each label matches the stated hazard reasoning for that step..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: checking safety and supervision — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the checking safety and supervision task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Was there a step you first thought was safe alone but labeled differently after checking the three hazards? Describe the step and what changed your mind.
observableCriteria: Hazard check accuracy: The heat, sharp tool, and chemical cleaner checks are applied consistently to label each step.
Supervision label defensibility: Each label matches the stated hazard reasoning for that step.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Hazard check accuracy: The heat, sharp tool, and chemical cleaner checks are applied consistently to label each step. | Supervision label defensibility: Each label matches the stated hazard reasoning for that step.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
